title: phegopteris subdigitata

It is a type of fern that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris subdigitata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator, making it useful in treating conditions such as high blood pressure and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Phegopteris subdigitata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
